ours.title: The path
ours.text: Reel, then one comment keyword, then an auto-DM, then the paid report or reading. The reel gives the general reading, complete in itself. The paid product gives the personal one.

ours.title: Proof it works
ours.text: The New Year 2026 mulank series sold a yearly report at Rs 555 and made about Rs 1.5 lakh.

ours.title: Series, not single reels
ours.text: 10 to 20 episodes, one look, one story, one product at the end. Pilot first; batches of 3 to 5 after it passes.

ours.title: Every episode follows TAROT
list: Thehro (0-3 s): stop the scroll, open one question
Apni baat (3-10 s): the viewer finds themselves
Reveal (10-38 s): one idea, one usable thing
On to the next (38-41 s): name the next episode
Take the step (41-45 s): one keyword, and what they get

ours.title: Three gates before anything is shown as ready
list: Follow: will they come back and send it on?

ours.title: How we speak
list: Patterns and tendencies, never "this will happen"
No fear, no curse, no secrecy hooks
No promise on money, health or a person returning
Say when the reel simplifies the method

ours.title: Nobody approves their own work
ours.text: Every idea, script, look and film goes to an independent reviewer. Only the owner approves.

scripts.title: 2027 driver series, episode 1
beats: Thehro
Two friends in one coach, both wearing a 5. The coach splits onto two tracks. Text: "Mulank same. Saal alag?"
Apni baat
"Aapka mulank + janm ka mahina + 2" on a lookup card.
Reveal
The engine cab; a saarthi steps out of the steam. "Hum ise aapke saal ka driver kehte hain." One friend's driver is 1, the other's is 7, and what that changes.
On to the next
"Kal: ek mulank, teen mahine, teen alag saal."
Take the step
"Comment DRIVER. DM mein aapka driver number aur 2027 report ki jaankari."

scripts.title: 2027 driver series, ten-episode outline
beats: Two friends with the same mulank split onto different tracks. The sum and the lookup grid.
One mulank, three birth months, three different years.
3 to 8
One theme each, all nine drivers inside: paisa, rishte, career, ghar, and two to decide. "Sehat" was flagged by a reviewer as a health-claim risk.
The same driver with mulank 1 and with mulank 7.
The report: what it gives, and the keyword.

playbook.name: Stop · Follow · Choose gates
playbook.line: Three pass/fail gates on every script and reel.
playbook.detail: Four checks per gate, run by a reviewer. A fail sends the work back before the owner sees it.

playbook.name: Independent reviewer
playbook.line: Nobody approves their own work.
playbook.detail: Every idea, script, look and film goes to a fresh reviewer. Used ten times so far; it changed the result every time.

playbook.name: Cover-sheet scouting
playbook.line: See a whole page's hooks in two pictures.
playbook.detail: Reads every cover line with its views in one screenshot per 12 reels. Used on @pagetkagy.

playbook.name: Median and the 3x rule
playbook.line: A hit is 3 times the page's typical reel.
playbook.detail: Median of recent reels, pinned and brand-new ones left out.

playbook.name: Claim test
playbook.line: Check a pattern against every reel, not just the hits.
playbook.detail: Killed two claims on the first page: "money does better" and "a clock in the hook does better".

playbook.name: TAROT episode shape
playbook.line: Thehro, Apni baat, Reveal, On to the next, Take the step.
playbook.detail: Version 2 written after one review; not re-checked. Not yet used in a finished script.

playbook.name: Three-hook opening
playbook.line: Screen action, first line and short text, planned together.
playbook.detail: Inside TAROT's first beat. Must work with the sound off.

playbook.name: Search words
playbook.line: Words people type go in speech, text, caption and cover.
playbook.detail: Not checked against Instagram's own guidance yet.

playbook.name: One idea per shot
playbook.line: One idea, two text items at most, safe areas kept clear.
playbook.detail: Came from the review that failed our first frames. To be proven in the next frames.

playbook.name: Lookup card
playbook.line: A small card so viewers find their own number in seconds.
playbook.detail: Mulank + birth month + 2. Planned for every episode.

playbook.name: Task with a return date
playbook.line: Give the viewer a job and a time to come back.
playbook.detail: 3 of her 4 recent hits. Planned: find your driver, comment it, come back on 1 January.

playbook.name: Named character
playbook.line: A character answers the viewer's wish.
playbook.detail: Her house format. Ours is the saarthi who drives the year.

playbook.name: Do / don't columns
playbook.line: Two columns, ticks and crosses, one pair per beat.
playbook.detail: Two reels only; the sequel did worse. Easy in motion graphics.

playbook.name: Timed promise
playbook.line: Name a length of time and what you will know after it.
playbook.detail: Mixed evidence: 12.3M and 1.0M, but also 252K to 311K.

playbook.name: Date anchor
playbook.line: Tie a practice to one calendar moment.
playbook.detail: One reel at 1.0M. Ours: 31 December and 1 January, as reflection, not ritual.

playbook.name: Real-words audience file
playbook.line: Build the audience from real comments and DMs.
playbook.detail: Waiting for last year's comments and DMs.

playbook.name: "This video found you"
playbook.line: Telling viewers the reel is a sign.
playbook.detail: A false prophecy. Second-highest group on her page, so it needs a clear no.

playbook.name: "Send it to yourself"
playbook.line: Sharing to your own chat as a ritual.
playbook.detail: Raises the share counter without anyone recommending the reel.

playbook.name: Secrecy and pressure hooks
playbook.line: "Don't tell anyone", "never be poor again".
playbook.detail: Breaks the honesty rules: no fear, no guaranteed outcome.

playbook.name: AI-guessed audience
playbook.line: Asking AI to invent the audience from the niche.
playbook.detail: Gives the same picture everyone else has.

playbook.name: Reel to keyword to DM to report
playbook.line: The selling path. Proven by the 2026 series.
playbook.detail: Rs 555 report, about Rs 1.5 lakh.

playbook.name: Series, not single reels
playbook.line: 10 to 20 episodes, one look, one product.
playbook.detail: Gives a posting schedule and time to build reach.

playbook.name: General free, personal paid
playbook.line: The reel is complete; the report is personal.
playbook.detail: Hold back quantity, never the punchline.

playbook.name: Pilot before batches
playbook.line: One full episode first, then 3 to 5 at a time.
playbook.detail: No batch before the pilot passes.

playbook.name: Level 2, not a correction
playbook.line: New work builds on last year's report.
playbook.detail: Never say the 2026 report was wrong.

playbook.name: Every episode for every viewer
playbook.line: No waiting for "my number's" episode.
playbook.detail: Each series bible must say how. Themes with all numbers inside is one way.

playbook.name: Personal year for 2027
playbook.line: Use day + month + 2027, not mulank alone.
playbook.detail: Needs Sakshi's say on how she reads the year.

playbook.name: Top reel as sales page
playbook.line: The pinned best reel carries the product pitch.
playbook.detail: Seen once. Worth trying when the series has a clear winner.

playbook.name: Daily snapshot
playbook.line: Read the reels list daily to see what keeps growing.
playbook.detail: Needs a scheduled agent run.

playbook.name: Percent weights from the funnel post
playbook.line: 40 / 30 / 20 / 10 per factor.
playbook.detail: No source found.

playbook.name: "Money topics do better"
playbook.line: Assumed; the numbers did not support it.
playbook.detail: 303K against 328K; 3 of 4 hits were not about money.

Stop: First 2 seconds show motion and the question, sound off
A stranger can say the hook after one viewing
One open question is held to the end
Follow: The viewer leaves with one usable thing
Same characters, colours and title card each episode
The ending names the next episode
A real reason to send it to someone
Choose: What the report gives, in one plain sentence
The free part is complete without buying
One comment keyword, shown and spoken
No fear, no guaranteed outcome, real proof only
